meta.note: Full-year monthly wind + rainfall model. rainStates use GADM NAME_1 keys (data/india-states.geo.json) for map highlight. dmiTyp = climatological typical DMI (neutral Nov-Apr, builds May, peaks Aug-Sep). Qualitative rainfall (heavy/moderate/light in rain text); no invented mm values. Sources per month in s.

months.label: JAN
months.rain: Tamil Nadu coast, S Kerala (NE tail); dry NW plains
months.note: Dry NW; Bay flow re-humidified rains Tamil Nadu (retreating NE monsoon tail).

months.label: FEB
months.rain: S Tamil Nadu light; rest dry

months.label: MAR
months.rain: Kerala, coastal Karnataka, NE states + Bengal (thunderstorms); hot dry interior
months.note: Loo builds; Nor'wester (Kalbaisakhi) from Bay in east.

months.label: APR
months.rain: Kerala coast, S Karnataka, TN, E India storms; interior hot
months.note: Hottest core; Bay storms feed east coast.

months.label: MAY
months.rain: Kerala pre-monsoon showers, NE heavy; Andaman onset mid-May
months.note: Somali jet spins up; Kerala onset ~24 May/1 Jun.

months.label: JUN
months.rain: Kerala, Konkan, W Ghats, NE, Bengal; advancing to central India
months.note: Arabian branch → W Ghats, Mumbai ~10 Jun. Bay branch → Kolkata ~7 Jun → Assam.

months.label: JUL
months.rain: All-India peak: W coast, central, Gangetic plain, NE; TN rain-shadow drier
months.note: Both branches merged near Delhi; trough Ganganagar–Calcutta.

months.label: AUG
months.rain: W coast + central in active; Himalayan foothills/NE/TN in break
months.note: Break = trough to foothills >2d. MJO phases gate active/break (Pai 2011).

months.label: SEP
months.rain: S peninsula + Odisha active; late showers Gujarat/Rajasthan; withdrawal mid-Sep NW
months.note: Withdrawal from W Rajasthan mid-Sep; NE flow returns south.

months.label: OCT
months.rain: Tamil Nadu, S Coastal AP, Rayalaseema, Kerala, S Karnataka (NE onset ~22 Oct ±7d)
months.note: SW withdraws; NE monsoon onset ~22 Oct ±7d over coastal TN/Puducherry/south AP.

months.label: NOV
months.wind: NE trades, Bay humidified → SE coast
months.rain: Tamil Nadu peak (>300mm), Coastal AP, Rayalaseema, S Karnataka, Kerala
months.note: Wettest NE month for TN/CAP; La Nina + active MJO Ph1-3 boost rain.

months.label: DEC
months.season: NE Monsoon — late / winter in N
months.wind: NE trades; dry NW, cold wave season N
months.rain: S Tamil Nadu, E Sri Lanka waters; NW dry + cold waves
months.note: NE rains retreat south; NW cold-wave season Nov-Mar peaks Jan.
